Three DC06s for $750 is the cheapest way in — 990 MH/s total, mining Dogecoin and Litecoin straight to your own wallet, and you keep the machines.

At 16¢ I'll run your exact monthly numbers next. Where would they run — garage, office, basement?
Read the hammer miner scrypt dc06 330 mh s page
Searched the catalog · Hammer DC06 scrypt bundle 3 pack

Three of them pull about 315 W together — roughly $36 a month at 16¢.

Living room is fine on heat, but be honest with yourself about noise: each one has an active fan, so three of them is a constant whoosh near the couch. Is a low fan hum something you'd live with there?

A den's the right room — door shuts, hum stays there.

That's 990 MH/s pointed at Doge and Litecoin, drawing for a real block around the clock, and you keep all three machines after every draw. $750 for the three, about $36 a month to run.

Want me to build the cart?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the 50% OFF numbers for where you live.
